entities.name: Southern City-States
entities.description: Twelve city-states of the Dark Age of Terisiare on Dominaria.

entities.name: Korlis
entities.description: Former Brothers' War nation that became one of the Southern City-States.

entities.name: Alsoor
entities.description: Inland city-state, home of Primata Delphine, later destroyed by a Diabolic Machine.

entities.name: Ghed
entities.description: Coastal city-state three days southwest of Alsoor, locked down by plague.

entities.name: Pitdown
entities.description: City near the Alamar River between Alsoor and Ghed; hills outside were the site of the Battle of Pitdown.

entities.name: Battle of Pitdown
entities.description: Battle between Alsoor and Ghed outside Pitdown.

entities.name: Primata Delphine
entities.description: Church of Tal leader of Alsoor who planted rumors to trap Sima.

entities.name: Jodah
entities.description: Fugitive from the Church of Tal who joined Ghed's army and gained immortality in a Fountain of Youth.

entities.name: Voska
entities.description: Arrested with Jodah in 430 AR; sacrificed himself so Jodah could escape.

entities.name: Sima
entities.description: Came to Alsoor on a rumor that Voska lived and was arrested; later discovered Jodah in Ghed.

entities.name: Fountain of Youth
entities.description: Fountain in which Jodah hid, granting him immortality.

entities.name: Kjeldorans
entities.description: Hardy people who later settled the territory.

events.summary: In 430 AR Jodah and Voska are arrested and taken to Alsoor; Voska sacrifices himself and Jodah escapes with the Rag Man's help.
events.quote: Voska sacrificed himself to draw the Church of Tal 's attention away from Jodah, who managed to escape with the help of the Rag Man .

events.summary: Delphine plants rumors that Voska lives and has Sima arrested.
events.quote: but the rumors had been planted by Delphine, and Sima was arrested

events.summary: Alsoor goes to war against Ghed, leading to the Battle of Pitdown.
events.quote: Alsoor went into a war against Ghed , resulting in the Battle of Pitdown .

events.summary: Alsoor is later destroyed by a Diabolic Machine.
events.quote: the city of Alsoor would be destroyed by a Diabolic Machine

events.summary: Jodah is trapped in plague-locked Ghed, exposed by Sima and the Church when his Alabaster Potion heals people, and joins Ghed's army to hide.
events.quote: To hide from the church, Jodah joined the army of Ghed in its war against Alsoor.

events.summary: After the Battle of Pitdown, Jodah hides in a Fountain of Youth and gains immortality as goblins plunder the city.
events.quote: Jodah hid in a Fountain of Youth , granting him immortality
